mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.from_user_id, bu_from.username AS from_username, bu_from.avatar AS from_avatar, m.to_user_id, bu_to.username AS to_username, bu_to.avatar AS to_avatar, m.content, m.message_type, m.status, m.create_time FROM chat_message m LEFT JOIN base_user bu_from ON m.from_user_id = bu_from.id LEFT JOIN base_user bu_to ON m.to_user_id = bu_to.id WHERE (m.from_user_id = #{userId1} AND m.to_user_id = #{userId2}) OR (m.from_user_id = #{userId2} AND m.to_user_id = #{userId1}) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId1} AND to_user_id = #{userId2}) OR (from_user_id = #{userId2} AND to_user_id = #{userId1})

SELECT other_user.id AS user_id, other_user.username, other_user.avatar, (SELECT cm.content FROM chat_message cm WHERE (cm.from_user_id = #{userId} AND cm.to_user_id = other_user.id) OR (cm.from_user_id = other_user.id AND cm.to_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY cm.create_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_content, (SELECT cm.message_type FROM chat_message cm WHERE (cm.from_user_id = #{userId} AND cm.to_user_id = other_user.id) OR (cm.from_user_id = other_user.id AND cm.to_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY cm.create_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_type, (SELECT cm.create_time FROM chat_message cm WHERE (cm.from_user_id = #{userId} AND cm.to_user_id = other_user.id) OR (cm.from_user_id = other_user.id AND cm.to_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY cm.create_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message cm WHERE cm.from_user_id = other_user.id AND cm.to_user_id = #{userId} AND cm.status = 0 ) AS unread_count FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN m.to_user_id ELSE m.from_user_id END AS other_id FROM chat_message m WHERE m.from_user_id = #{userId} OR m.to_user_id = #{userId} ) conversations JOIN base_user other_user ON other_user.id = conversations.other_id ORDER BY last_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
